name: Node-Link Flow (3 nodes)
easing: nodes EASE.inOut 14f at f0/22/44; arrows EASE.inOut 12f at f14/36; pulse ring EASE.out f60-84
bestFor: A 3-step flow with one highlighted step ('Hairspring -> 3D Explode -> 3D Space').
notSuitable: Flows with branches or >3 nodes (use A24/A21).
keyframeTable: node 1 done, arrow 1 drawn, node 2 starting
node 2 orange, arrow 2 drawing, node 3 starting
all done, pulse ring starting around node 2
script: Node 1 draws with icon and label.
Arrow 1 draws, node 2 (orange) appears, arrow 2 draws, node 3 appears.
An orange ring expands around the highlighted node and fades.

params.nodes: array of 3 {label<=12 chars, icon: ICONS key}
